patch.summary: Is Carepatron worth it? Carepatron is practice management software for healthcare providers — scheduling, clinical notes, client management, billing, and telehealth. Published pricing includes a free tier with paid plans for growing practices (2026-08-19 — confirm live on carepatron…. Strong when Solo and small healthcare/wellness practices. Weak when Healthcare practice scope — not general HRIS.
